A little background

I've kept building.

At 13, I worked with developers on a Minecraft server that caught the attention of the creators of Mineplex. I built my first PC in 2015. That interest in computers grew into a career in product delivery and business analysis.

I'm based in Nashville and graduated from Vanderbilt. Away from work, I'm into fantasy football, video games, golf, and pickleball. I also have two dogs, Margot and Quinn.
